Apparently, Morocco was in Indiana, Amsterdam, Paris, China and Egypt were originally in America too! 😲 The Moroccan flag is thousands of years old, and Freemasonry means “Mother and Son”?! 😲🤣🤣 You couldn’t make this stuff up!  At what point do we stop rewriting history to fit a narrative and actually start researching? Before making grand claims about the origins of civilisation, countries, flags or organisations, perhaps take a moment to research the actual history and, importantly, the meaning and origins of the words you’re using. Mason doesn’t mean Mother and Son. Freemasonry has a documented history, and its terminology has nothing to do with that invented interpretation. Satire aside, there’s a serious point here: question everything, but don’t abandon critical thinking in the process. History deserves research, not creative fiction presented as hidden truth. 🤷🏾‍♂️ #morocco #Africanhistory #comedy #identitycrisis #blacktiktok

Four days in Marrakech, Morocco and I already can't wait to go back! 🇲🇦✨ If you’re planning your first trip to Morocco, Marrakech is the perfect place to dive into the country’s rich culture, incredible food, and beautiful architecture. Between getting lost in the medina, learning to cook traditional Moroccan dishes, and enjoying a little luxury in the Agafay Desert, we packed SO much into four days! One thing I loved most about Marrakech was how every day felt completely different. You can spend one morning exploring centuries of history and the next relaxing poolside with views of the Atlas Mountains. And the hospitality? Some of the best I’ve experienced. 🥹 My biggest recommendation is to leave some room in your Marrakech itinerary to wander, shop, and enjoy the city without rushing from one attraction to the next. 📌 Save this 4-day Marrakech itinerary for your Morocco vacation, and tell me: Would you rather spend a day exploring the souks or relaxing in the Agafay Desert? #MarrakechMorocco #MarrakechItinerary #MoroccoTravel #VisitMarrakech #blacktravelblogger things to do in Marrakech, Marrakech itinerary

5 things to know before going to Morocco👇🇲🇦 1️⃣ Always carry cash. Morocco is still very cash-based, especially in local shops, markets and smaller restaurants. 💵 2️⃣ Be a responsible tourist. Think twice before paying for animal encounters in Marrakech, particularly the monkeys and snakes in Jemaa el-Fnaa. 🐒 3️⃣ Explore beyond Marrakech. Some of Morocco’s best experiences are outside the city, so make time for places like Chefchaouen, Volubilis and the Atlas Mountains. 🏜️ 4️⃣ Having mobile data when you land makes your arrival so much easier. I use Unpack for my travels. Download the app and use code "ALEX" for 20% off your first eSIM plan. (Link in bio)📱 5️⃣ If you’re visiting on a Friday, make sure you try traditional Moroccan couscous.
